purpose: Teach: 司祭/殿下/教皇/暗黒/破滅/連行/暴落/批准

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ホスピスで司祭が患者さんを慰める光景を貴院、ご紹介されたとのこと、先生
lines.en: Ren — I heard your hospital introduced the scene of a priest comforting patients in hospice care.
lines.style: Steady, clear opening. Clinical warmth without condescension. Measured pace. The tone of someone asking a genuine question she already knows the answer to, testing his thinking.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 王室の殿下が貴院をご訪問されたのですね、先生
lines.en: A royal visit to your hospital—is that right, Doctor?
lines.style: Tentative, genuine curiosity. Slight upward lift at the end—not challenging, asking for clarification. Respectful but engaged, leaning in to understand.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、教皇のご訪問時の医療体制を医療チームで整えました
lines.en: Yes. When the Pope visited, our medical team coordinated the entire care structure.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact precision. No embellishment. A small pause before the verb—the weight of that coordination. Steady eye-line delivery, as if stating a fact that speaks for itself.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 暗黒時代の医療記録を、貴院、研究なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital has been researching medical records from the Dark Ages?
lines.style: Slow, thoughtful delivery. Slight hesitation—he's working through the implications as he speaks. Respectful tone, but genuinely trying to understand the connection he's being shown.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 感染拡大の破滅的事態を医療チームで防ぎました
lines.en: Yes. When infection began to spread dangerously, our medical team worked to prevent catastrophe.
lines.style: Quiet authority without drama. Each clause lands with equal weight. No rise in urgency—the steadiness itself conveys the gravity. The tone of someone who was there.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、警察と協力して薬物乱用者を連行された事例ありましたね、先生
lines.en: There was a case where your hospital cooperated with police to apprehend someone with a substance abuse problem—wasn't there?
lines.style: Careful phrasing, respectful tone. Slower pace. He's framing a sensitive question delicately—not accusing, genuinely trying to understand the hospital's role. Slight trailing-off before the question mark.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、健康指標の暴落に医療チームは警鐘を鳴らします
lines.en: Yes. When health indicators plummeted sharply, our medical team sounded the alarm.
lines.style: Quiet insistence. The word 'alarm' lands with weight. No hesitation—the certainty of someone who was watching closely and acted. Composed surface, steady conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 国際医療条約の批准が、貴院でも議論されておられますね、先生
lines.en: International medical treaty ratification—your hospital is discussing that too, isn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Slower, more reflective cadence now. The question trails softly at the end—almost thinking aloud. Respectful, almost meditative. The tone of someone working toward understanding something larger than himself.
